name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-06-13, at wavelengths from 1.20 to 4.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
